page.overview:
Who is Noi?

Noi is the placeholder name of a filly Earth pony seen in several episodes engaging in activities with other foals. Noi has a light golden coat, a light orange mane, and purple eyes. In Call of the Cutie, she sports many cutie marks, including a magnifying glass, a pillow, and a cupcake; in Rainbow Falls, her cutie mark again is a magnifying glass; in Simple Ways, her cutie mark sometimes again is a magnifying glass; in Parental Glideance, her cutie mark yet again is a magnifying glass. In other episodes, she has no cutie mark at all.__TOC__

She shares her design with Aura and "Piña Colada".

She, along with "Tornado Bolt", Cotton Cloudy, "Princess Erroria", Aura, Liza Doolots, and "Dinky Doo" and as well as Prim Posy, Lemony Gem, "Serena", "Pinkie Feather", "Rainy Feather", "Mango Dash", and "Sweet Pop", was to appear in Friendship is Magic, part 2.

Noi first appears in Call of the Cutie in Cheerilee's class with a magnifying glass as her cutie mark; she later appears at Diamond Tiara's cute-ceañera with a pillow (and later a chocolate ice cream) cutie mark.
